entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6255978483510095488: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 17.6353 +/- 0.0492 mas (same row, RUWE 1.14): 56.70 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -120.013, 74.471 mas/yr. Radial velocity from No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 6255978483510095488 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 20,000 of its distance per century.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.196 +/- 0.006 solar radii from Niraula et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-315 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..172N/abstract). Mass 0.174 +/- 0.004 solar masses from Niraula et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-315 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020AJ....160..172N/abstract). Temperature 3300 +/- 30 K from Niraula et al. 2020, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-315 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,300 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc180. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band at 3,300 K and log g 5.09 (u1 0.152, u2 0.462): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
